description: Search Zadely’s AI-made browser games by text, genre, credited AI tool, engine, multiplayer, or phone support. Classic ports of commercial games are not searchable here. Each result includes pageUrl (cite this) and playUrl (where the creator hosts the game), plus credited AI tools and engine.

ai_tool.description: AI tool credited by the creator. Partial names work: claude, claude-code, codex, cursor, grok, gemini, gpt.

engine.description: Engine or renderer, such as Three.js, Godot, PixiJS, Unity, or HTML5 Canvas.

genre.description: Genre slug or label, such as racing, puzzle, rpg, or "Action & Shooters".

limit.description: How many games to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 25.

mobile.description: True: only games the creator says work on a phone. False: only games without a phone note.

multiplayer.description: True: only games that support multiplayer. False: only single-player games.

query.description: Words matched against the name, description, genre, AI tools, engine, and award. Every word must match.

name: search_games
title: Search AI browser games
